title: Revert "ci(test-shards): grade the Test Core split on predicted shard wall and slice the CLI per run (#22415)"
body:
Part of #22075
Clause-②: no

Reverts PR #22415 (`c64130bafa`), made with `git revert --no-edit c64130bafa`. Since it landed, full runs on `main` and in the merge queue red `Test Core` at the step "Check this shard's timing drift", while the step "Run this shard's tests" passes on the same shard. Each red removes a PR from the queue and rebuilds every group behind it.

## Diagnosis

From the seat's revert-round claim (`6076043190`, "Why a revert") and the `domain:services` seat 2 data note (`6076007681`) on the card:

- PR #22415 packs about 2,000–3,000 s of predicted windows onto each whole-package shard. The drift step's prediction is the dataset's per-package windows, and those were measured on shards carrying about 1,400 s.
- Under 4-wide concurrency each package's window inflates on the denser shards: `objectql` 1.84x, `plugin-security` 1.80x, `rest` 1.61x, `plugin-auth` 1.87x (seat claim). The drift step's red is 1.5x.
- The red is not deterministic. Some groups pass because the shards sit at the line. The dense packing is the part that misses, and a fix forward needs a contention-aware design. That design is the card's next round, not a hotfix.

**Red full runs.** Each was re-read from the jobs API in this round. In every one, the drift step is `failure` and "Run this shard's tests" is `success` on the same shard.

| run | event | red shard(s) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 37894048074 | push, `main` at `e02833c240` | 4/6, 6/6 |
| 37894050587 | merge_group, PR #22412 on `e02833c240` | 6/6 |
| 37893672824 | merge_group, PR #22426 on `628df0cc` | 5/6 |
| 37894053453 | merge_group, PR #22426 on `b0a4aed6` | 5/6 |
| 37892033675 | merge_group, PR #22396 on `e02833c2` | 6/6 |

The drift line from 37894048074, `Test Core (6/6)`, job 113701465749:

```text
shard-timing-drift: DRIFT -- Test Core (6/6), 3992.4s measured vs 2467.1s predicted across 13 package(s) = 1.62x (warning past 1.3x, red past 1.5x).
    @objectstack/objectql: predicted 551.9s, measured 1054.9s (1.91x, +503.0s)
    @objectstack/rest: predicted 508.3s, measured 865.2s (1.70x, +356.9s)
    @objectstack/plugin-security: predicted 391.5s, measured 713.1s (1.82x, +321.6s)
```

The data note's rows: 37892033675 shard 6/6 read 3028.0 s against 1962.3 s (1.54x), and 37893672824 shard 5/6 read 2904.1 s against 1828.0 s (1.59x).

## What full runs read before `c64130bafa` (the state this restores)

- `main` push 37888117205 (`27a8b33dec`): the drift step is `success` on all six shards.
  - `Test Core (1/6)`: `1885.9s measured vs 1766.8s predicted across 4 package(s) = 1.07x`.
  - `Test Core (6/6)`: `2136.1s measured vs 1766.1s predicted across 13 package(s) = 1.21x`.
- `main` push 37883152892 (`abd254508b`): the drift step is `success` on all six shards. These are the step conclusions from the jobs API; the log lines were not read.
- merge_group 37875522518 (the PR #22390 group): the drift step is `success` on all six shards. `c64130bafa`'s own `ci.yml` comment records shard 1/6 at 1.07x and shard 2/6 at 0.74x there.
- Same shard, same 13 packages: shard 6/6's prediction rose from 1766.1 s to 2467.1 s under the reverted model, and its ratio went from 1.21x to 1.62x.

## Proof

- **Byte identity with the reverted commit's single parent**, at head `b49b02297d`:
  - `git diff f05649f6aa HEAD -- .github/workflows/ci.yml scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` prints nothing (0 bytes).
  - The blob ids match at `f05649f6aa`, at `HEAD` and on disk: `ci.yml` `0d2576cbf2`, `partition-test-shards.mjs` `a7c6fc76ec`.
  - The diff against `main` is exactly these 2 files, +184/−576.
  - Nothing on `origin/main` touched either file, or `scripts/test-shard-timings.json`, after `c64130bafa` (read again at `b9222dc701`).
- **Self-test** on the reverted tree: `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test` exits 0:
  `partition-test-shards: self-test OK (72 measured packages -> 72 shard items, 6 shards, max/mean 1.00x <= 1.3x, floor 1739s, bins 1771/1773/1772/1772/1772/1771s, file-level slices: none)`.
  The dataset is unchanged since `f05649f6aa`.
- **Gates**, derived on this diff with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `b49b02297d`: 58 commands.
  - 53 exit 0, including `check:stall-guard-budget` (Test Core: cap 20m against budget 45m), `check:required-contexts`, `check:shard-attestation` and `check:nul-bytes`.
  - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` printed `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2011 cases pass.` (1071.5 s). It ran in the background, and its exit code was not captured. The verdict line is quoted instead.
  - 4 are NOT MEASURED, exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (they read built `dist/`, and this diff touches no package): `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`.
  - Reconciliation, `--ran` at `b49b02297d`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 58 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 54 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (⛔ a FLOOR — 4 derived from exit 3; 1 of 58 recorded no exit code).`

## Scope

- Two files: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs`, both restored to `f05649f6aa`.
- No fix forward, no constant tuned, and no self-test case added. The redesign is the card's next round, decided by the owning seat.
- `skip-changeset`: root `scripts/` and workflows publish nothing.
- The card stays open. Its post-landing read (`6075708656`) no longer applies once this lands, because the change it measured is gone.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch cited the pre-change drift range as 0.61x–1.07x. That range describes shard 1/6 only: 0.61x–1.05x on eight scheduled `main` runs, per the restored `ci.yml` comment, and 1.07x on 37875522518 and 37888117205. Shards 2–6 read higher before the change; shard 6/6 on 37888117205 read 1.21x. That is green, and under the 1.3x warning. Carrier: the seat's redesign brief for the card's next round.
